text:
Jordan (People Ops): FYI Luca submitted resignation today, effective 2026-04-10. Starting offboard thread to coordinate access removal, benefits wrap, and exit interview scheduling.
Carmen (Benefits): Got it. COBRA coverage will terminate end-of-month (2026-04-30). I will DM Luca COBRA enrollment steps and deadlines. @Luca please confirm preferred mailing address. :envelope_with_arrow:
Luca: Confirm address: 1128 Redwood Ave, Apt 3, San Francisco, CA 94107. Thanks Carmen.
Alex G (IT): I can handle SSO & device flow. Proposed schedule: disable Google/Okta 2026-04-11 09:00 PST, revoke SSH keys and API tokens 2026-04-11 21:00 PST (off-peak), laptop wipe/collection window 2026-04-13 - 2026-04-15. Need confirmation of any service keys.
Jordan (People Ops): Luca has an infra deploy key and a billing webhook token. Adding names here so IT/SRE can revoke: infra-monitoring-deploy-key, billing-webhook-token-72.
SRE Oncall: I will search for any long-lived tokens and service accounts tied to luca@redwood.com and post findings by EOD.
Alex G (IT): Revoke commands I will run (for audit trail):
```
# Okta
okta users deactivate --login luca@redwood.com
# GitHub deploy key
gh repo remove-deploy-key infra-monitoring infra-monitoring-deploy-key
# Vault token
vault kv delete secret/data/tokens/billing-webhook-token-72
```
Jordan (People Ops): Please attach the audit IDs after you run them. @IT Ops Bot please open ticket PO-4789 with the offboard steps and pickup window.
IT Ops Bot: Ticket PO-4789 created and assigned to Alex G, due 2026-04-13.
Carmen (Benefits): Quick note on payroll/benefits: final paycheck (including PTO payout if applicable) will process on payroll run 2026-04-15. COBRA notices are separate and will be mailed with election forms. 401(k) distribution options will be sent within 5 business days after separation; Luca will need to sign to elect rollover/withdrawal.
Luca: Thanks. Will the exit interview be before the last day? Im fine with that.
Jordan (People Ops): Prefer before final day so folks can speak candidly. Proposing exit interview on 2026-04-10 11:00 and benefits walk-through on 2026-04-09 10:00. Luca, are those okay?
Luca: Yep 4/09 and 4/10 times work. Morning is best.
Alex G (IT): One more: confirm whether any GCP projects or transfer-needed repos exist. If not, Ill archive or transfer ownership as needed.
Luca: I have one personal experiment repo (luca/sync-demo) ll make public and transfer before the 11th. No GCP projects.
Jordan (People Ops): Final checklist items for PO-4789: badge return, laptop asset tag, Slack message archive per retention policy, expense reimbursements processed by 4/15, and confirm COBRA packet sent. Ill update the ticket with assignees and deadlines. :white_check_mark:
SRE Oncall: Found two references to luca@redwood.com in monitoring roles for a read-only Grafana dashboard; Ill change the role to service-account-monitoring and rotate creds 2026-04-11 22:00 PST.
Alex G (IT): Thanks. Ill coordinate the rotation with the fallback deploy. Will post audit IDs when done.
Jordan (People Ops): Great work team. Ill send calendar invites, the post-exit survey link, and confirm when PO-4789 is all green.
Luca: Appreciate the help.
